project.title: A novel approach for achieving ultra-high enrichment of anaerobic ammonium oxidizing bacteria and nitrogen removal rate in municipal wastewater treatment: A pure biofilm process without suspended sludge
project.description: Metagenomic sequencing revealed the carbon and nitrogen metabolic pathways of functional bacteria in the pure biofilm system, showing that AnAOBs metabolic diversity and ecological niche adaptation within the biofilm structure drove their self-enrichment.
